reviews.title: Excellent Sound and Comfort!
reviews.comment: The Logitech G321 Lightspeed headset is amazing! The sound quality is crisp and immersive, perfect for gaming or music. The fit is super comfortable even after long sessions, and the battery easily lasts over 20 hours. I love the wireless and Bluetooth options — seamless connection to my PC. The mic is clear, and overall the build feels solid and premium. Totally worth it!
reviews.author: D.Ellen

reviews.title: Extremely comfortable and flexible Definitely worth the price!
reviews.comment: Very comfortable and extremely light. They fit perfectly over my afro and I had even forgotten that they were resting on my head at some point. The band is very flexible and seems to be durable, but only time will tell, but in my first couple weeks it’s survived a couple drops and a lot of stretching to fit over my hair. The ear cups can press on your ears and hurt a bit if you have them at weird angles for a long time or if you have very large ears, but overall they are very soft. The microphone is clear enough for gaming and my friends haven’t complained which I see as a win. Very good product especially for the price and would buy again even if my current pair broke.
reviews.author: Leo

reviews.title: Super lightweight and great value
reviews.comment: Great quality and super lightweight I was surprised how light it was and it's great that I can switch between Bluetooth and the USB dongle with a press of a button and is also has good battery life and last quite long without a charge
reviews.author: Matthew Nissen

reviews.title: Stay away from wireless logitech headphones!!
reviews.comment: Terrible headset. Do NOT buy wireless logitech headphones! I've had the absolute worst experiences with them. This one specifically has the issue where there is a constant delay when the mic is on. Everytime I would play a game and had my mic on, there would be a 1 second delay from the game visuals and my audio. In fast paced competetive games 1 second is absolutely unacceptable and makes it unplayable. The only way to fix this issue is to either, have the mic on before you turn the headset on, which didn't even work every single time, or to simply not use the microphone and have it set to off. Even if you do turn the mic on before turning the headset on, what if you need to mute the mic and then turn it back on? Well, guess what, that would reintroduce the horrible delay. I don't want to deal with this BS in the middle of a competetive game. Unplugging wireless logitech headphone dongles from pc ports midgame also results in a total system crash, forcing you to restart your pc. Happened on two fully functional pcs with two different wireless logitech headphones. Just don't buy wireless logitech headphones, please. You'll save yourself a headache and money. As for everything else, this headset doesn't really have much going for it. The audio quality is decent at best, it has a pretty bad battery life, less than 24 hours. The only positive thing about it is the comfort, it's light on the head and doesn't make you want to take it off after several hours. Besides that, bad headset.
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.title: Good
reviews.comment: The Logitech G321 Lightspeed headset has been awesome so far. It’s super comfortable for long gaming sessions and fits well without feeling too tight. The sound quality is clear, and the 16 kHz boom mic picks up my voice nicely. I also love the long battery life — easily lasts over 20 hours. Works perfectly with my PC and consoles, and Bluetooth makes it easy to switch to my phone. Overall, a solid wireless headset for the price!
reviews.author: Lina
